div.div: Every box is a Flux Kustomization under clusters/aws-0/ or clusters/gcp-0/. Arrows are spec.dependsOn — Flux will not apply a Kustomization until the ones it points at are Ready. A path written aws-0 · gcp-0 is per-cluster: each cluster applies its own overlay of the same shared base.

div.div:
Suspended. spec.suspend: true, and it is deliberately a sibling of clusters/aws-0/ so the flux-system Kustomization's recursive sync cannot reach its children and apply them behind the suspend. Nothing under it runs until:
flux resume kustomization llm-platform -n flux-system

div.div: The constitution states the hierarchy as namespaces → CRDs → Crossplane → EPIs → security → infrastructure → observability → apps. That is the simplified model; this is the graph the manifests actually declare, and the differences are real: karpenter branches off crds rather than waiting for Crossplane, infrastructure joins two chains, tooling waits on both observability and infrastructure, and zitadel waits on both security and infrastructure.
